```{r, include=FALSE}
### Set working directory
rm(list=ls())

### Set working directory
setwd("/mnt/bmh01-rds/mrc-multi-outcome/Project_8.2/")

### Source functions
R.func.sources <- list.files("R", full.names = TRUE)
sapply(R.func.sources, source)

### Load functions
source("R/sim_functions.R")

### Call libraries
library(ggplot2)

### Read in data
metadata <- readRDS("data/sim_study4_metadata.rds")

### Split metadata into boservations both are recorded, and obserations just Riley recorded
metadata.both <- subset(metadata, !is.na(S.pop.mean.riley) & !is.na(S.pop.mean.pavlou))
metadata.all.riley <- subset(metadata, !is.na(S.pop.mean.riley))
metadata.just.riley <- subset(metadata, !is.na(S.pop.mean.riley) & is.na(S.pop.mean.pavlou))

### See how many just riley
sum(is.na(metadata$S.pop.mean.riley) & is.na(metadata$S.pop.mean.pavlou))
sum(!is.na(metadata$S.pop.mean.riley) & is.na(metadata$S.pop.mean.pavlou))
sum(!is.na(metadata$S.pop.mean.riley) & is.na(metadata$S.pop.mean.pavlou))/nrow(metadata)

### Write a function to get the quantiles for a given range of C-statistics
get_quantiles <- function(C1,C2,correlated = TRUE, both = TRUE, magnitude = FALSE){
  
  if (both == TRUE){
    ## Subset
    df <- subset(metadata.both, C.pop > C1 & C.pop <= C2 & corr == correlated)
    
    ## Calculate quantiles
    quantiles.riley <- quantile(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.riley), p = c(0.025,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.975))
    quantiles.pavlou <- quantile(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.pavlou), p = c(0.025,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.975))
    
    ## Calculate mean/median difference from 0.9
    mean.riley <- mean(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.riley) - 0.9)
    sd.riley <- sd(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.riley) - 0.9)
    median.riley <- median(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.riley) - 0.9)
    
    mean.pavlou <- median(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.pavlou) - 0.9)
    sd.pavlou <- sd(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.pavlou) - 0.9)
    median.pavlou <- median(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.pavlou) - 0.9)
    
    mean.mag.riley <- mean(abs(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.riley) - 0.9))
    sd.mag.riley <- sd(abs(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.riley) - 0.9))
    median.mag.riley <- median(abs(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.riley) - 0.9))
    
    mean.mag.pavlou <- median(abs(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.pavlou) - 0.9))
    sd.mag.pavlou <- sd(abs(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.pavlou) - 0.9))
    median.mag.pavlou <- median(abs(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.pavlou) - 0.9))
    
  } else {
    ## Subset
    df <- subset(metadata.just.riley, C.pop > C1 & C.pop <= C2 & corr == correlated)
    
    ## Calculate quantiles
    quantiles.riley <- quantile(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.riley), p = c(0.025,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.975))
    quantiles.pavlou <- NA
    
    ## Calculate mean/median difference from 0.9
    mean.riley <- mean(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.riley) - 0.9)
    sd.riley <- sd(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.riley) - 0.9)
    median.riley <- median(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.riley) - 0.9)
    
    mean.pavlou <- NA
    sd.pavlou <- NA
    median.pavlou <- NA
    
    mean.mag.riley <- mean(abs(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.riley) - 0.9))
    sd.mag.riley <- sd(abs(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.riley) - 0.9))
    median.mag.riley <- median(abs(as.numeric(df$S.pop.mean.riley) - 0.9))
    
    
    mean.mag.pavlou <- NA
    sd.mag.pavlou <- NA
    median.mag.pavlou <- NA
    
  }
  
  ## Concatenate
  quantiles.riley <- c(sprintf("%.3f", quantiles.riley), 
                       paste(sprintf("%.3f", mean.riley), " (", sprintf("%.3f", sd.riley), ")", sep = ""), 
                       paste(sprintf("%.3f", mean.mag.riley), " (", sprintf("%.3f", sd.mag.riley), ")", sep = ""))
  quantiles.pavlou <- c(sprintf("%.3f", quantiles.pavlou), 
                        paste(sprintf("%.3f", mean.pavlou), " (", sprintf("%.3f", sd.pavlou), ")", sep = ""), 
                        paste(sprintf("%.3f", mean.mag.pavlou), " (", sprintf("%.3f", sd.mag.pavlou), ")", sep = ""))
  
  return(list("riley" = quantiles.riley,
              "pavlou" = quantiles.pavlou))
}

### Write a function to get the quantiles for a given range of C-statistics
get_N <- function(C1,C2,correlated = TRUE, both = TRUE){
  if (both == TRUE){
    df <- subset(metadata.both, C.pop > C1 & C.pop <= C2 & corr == correlated)
  } else {
    df <- subset(metadata.just.riley, C.pop > C1 & C.pop <= C2 & corr == correlated)
  }
  n <- nrow(df)
  return(n)
}

### Put S_VH by quantiles ranges into a list
C.list <- list(c(0,1), 
               c(0.55, 0.6),
               c(0.6, 0.65),
               c(0.65, 0.7),
               c(0.7, 0.75),
               c(0.75, 0.8),
               c(0.8, 0.85),
               c(0.85, 0.9),
               c(0.9, 0.95))
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
# Correlated data
S.pop.stratified.C <- lapply(C.list, function(x) {get_quantiles(x[1],x[2])})
S.pop.stratified.C.riley <- lapply(C.list, function(x) {get_quantiles(x[1],x[2], both = FALSE)})

### Put into a table
S.pop.stratified.C <- lapply(S.pop.stratified.C, function(x) {
  out <- rbind(x[[1]], x[[2]])
  out <- cbind(c("N_original", "N_sim"), out)
  colnames(out) <- c("sample_size", 
                     paste("p", c(2.5,25,50,75,97.5), sep = ""), 
                     "mean (sd) of bias", 
                     "mean (sd) of |bias|")
  return(out)
})

### Suppress warnings for scenarios where N_adapted fails, as they give all NA, but we are only interetes in the results for N_original
S.pop.stratified.C.riley <- suppressWarnings(lapply(S.pop.stratified.C.riley, function(x) {
  out <- rbind(x[[1]], x[[2]])
  out <- cbind(c("N_original", "N_sim"), out)
  colnames(out) <- c("sample_size", 
                     paste("p", c(2.5,25,50,75,97.5), sep = ""), 
                     "mean (sd) of bias", 
                     "mean (sd) of |bias|")
  return(out)
}))

                                C = c(rep("[0,1]", 2),
                                          rep("(0.55,0.6]", 2),
                                          rep("(0.6,0.65]", 2),
                                          rep("(0.65,0.7]", 2),
                                          rep("(0.7,0.75]", 2),
                                          rep("(0.75,0.8]", 2),

                                          rep("(0.85,0.9]", 2),
                                          rep("(0.9,0.95]", 2)
                                    )) |>

S.pop.stratified.C.riley <- do.call("rbind", S.pop.stratified.C.riley) |> as.data.frame()
S.pop.stratified.C.riley <- dplyr::mutate(S.pop.stratified.C.riley, 
                                    C = c(rep("[0,1]", 2),
                                          rep("(0.55,0.6]", 2),
                                          rep("(0.6,0.65]", 2),
                                          rep("(0.65,0.7]", 2),
                                          rep("(0.7,0.75]", 2),
                                          rep("(0.75,0.8]", 2),
                                          rep("(0.8,0.85]", 2),
                                          rep("(0.85,0.9]", 2),
                                          rep("(0.9,0.95]", 2)
                                    )) |>

### Get number of scenarios in each C-statistic range

                                     "(0.6,0.65]",

                                     "(0.9,0.95]"),

N.stratified.C.riley <- lapply(C.list, function(x) {get_N(x[1],x[2], both = FALSE)})

N.stratified.C.riley <- data.frame("C" = c("[0,1]",

                                           "(0.85,0.9]",

                                   "Number_of_scenarios" = N.stratified.C.riley)

### Combine
S.pop.stratified.C <- dplyr::left_join(S.pop.stratified.C, N.stratified.C, by = dplyr::join_by(C))
### Combine

knitr::kable(S.pop.stratified.C, caption = "Supplementary Table 8.1: Simulation study 2 (alternative DGM - see section 4); Distribution of S_opt across different C-statistic groups in scenarios where N_sim converged; correlated data")
knitr::kable(S.pop.stratified.C.riley, caption = "Supplementary Table 8.2: Simulation study 2 (alternative DGM - see section 4); Distribution of S_opt across different C-statistic groups in scenarios where N_sim failed to converged; correlated data")
```

# Proportion of scenarios where N_sim failed

```{r, include = FALSE}
metadata.either  <- subset(metadata, !is.na(S.pop.mean.riley))

get_prop_miss <- function(C1, C2, correlated = TRUE){
  df <- subset(metadata, C.pop > C1 & C.pop <= C2 & corr == correlated & !is.na(S.pop.mean.riley))
  prop_out <- sum(is.na(df$S.pop.mean.pavlou)/nrow(df))
  return(prop_out)
}
```


```{r, echo = FALSE}

prop.miss.stratified.C <- data.frame("C" = c("[0,1]",
                                             "(0.55,0.6]",
```
